lines: An hour before the new year dawned.
A lineup of familiar faces had gathered at Gosha Academy's main gate.
「Good thing it's clear tonight. This is perfect countdown weather.」
「Figures Fuuma'd be the last one here.」
Hebiko, Yukikaze, Clear, Karasu the Yatagarasu child, and Shikanosuke.
All the people who had arrived before me criticized me simultaneously.
「Oi oi, I'm right on time for the rendezvous, aren't I?」
「What're you doing, showing up exactly on time? At times like this, it's natural to arrive a little early, y'know. You've got no common sense!」
「You're not very good at this kind of thing, are you, Fuuma-chan?」
「Well, sor-ry. Sakura was taking her time, as usual.」
「Hey!! Don't pin the blame on me all of a sudden!」
Sakura, who was hiding in my shadow, slid out to complain.
「It's 'cause you were taking ages, isn't it? Even though you were only changing into your Taimanin suit!」
「Tsk-tsk. Fuuma-kun doesn't get it, does he?」
「It's the New Year's countdown! This is Taimanin formalwear!」
「I'm gonna rock the look even more than usual, so of course it's going to take time, isn't it?」
「If that's the case, then do your prepping earlier.」
「Fu fu. I did, but it fell behind schedule.」
「Don't say that like you're proud of it.」
「Honestly. You can't even escort a girl properly.」
「Yukikaze-chan, that would be way too hard for Fuuma-chan.」
I was being spoken about pretty badly. A man's standing was delicate at times like these.
「Whatever, let's go already! We'll look stupid if we miss the countdown, right?」
Shikanosuke, my sole ally (although he didn't seem too out-of-place, mixed among the girls), smoothed things over for me.
「Fuuma, as punishment for being late, you carry these.」
Yukikaze pointed at some large paper bags that had been left on the ground.
「Salmon kanpu-boshi.」(TL: Fish dried in a salt breeze.)
「I won first place in a Scandinavian game tournament recently, you know. Did you see that?」
「Thanks. So, y'see, as a prize for winning, I got a year's supply of salmon, so I had the old man make this.」
「But it's more than we can eat at home, so I brought it here to hand out to everyone.」
「You didn't have to bring anything here today.」
There were several whole kanpu-boshi, in two paper bags.
This year, we had arranged to meet up to do the New Year's countdown.
Our destination was Mikuruma (御車) Shrine.
It was an old shrine, which had been there since long before Gosha Village was established.
Such was its extreme age that it wasn't even clear which deity it enshrined, but it had been subject to worship by shinobi since time immemorial.
Since 御車 could also be read as “Gosha”, it seemed to have something to do with the origins of the village.
Due to the fact that we would be welcoming the new year at such an esteemed and historic shrine, we were all dressed formally, in our Taimanin suits.
All the same, it was a little cold, though...
Mikuruma Shrine was at the summit of the mountain to the rear of Gosha Academy.
With our Taimanin legs, as long as there was an hour to go, we would reach it with time to spare.
「It'll be my first time getting together with everyone to do the New Year's countdown, like this.」
「Oh, that's a surprise. Hebiko would've imagined Yukikaze-chan gets together with friends every year.」
「Mmm, not really. Like, last year, I was doing an end-of-the-year gaming stream.」
「Y-kazeX-chan, huh? That sounds fun in its own way, though.」
「Well, I guess. This year I've got Clear and Karasu too, so I figured, why don't we all get together? Right?」
「That's unusual, on a mountain road like this.」
「The cat reminds me. Actually, I was thinking I should bring those boys along too.」
「You have yet more freeloaders at Castle Yukikaze?」
「They're not housemates, but I've got shinobi bears and snakes and stuff, remember.」
「In the old days, Heberybody used to get together at Fuuma-chan's mansion, didn't we?」
「That really was a long time ago.」
「You mean... like, a Fuuma clan gathering kind of thing?」
「Since I told her I was going out tonight, she invited Saika and Amane over to celebrate.」
「So, Fuuma-chan had to run away, right?」
「I'd be too scared to stay home.」
「Don't be ridiculous. I'd have three chaperones.」
「There's one man, Library-san, with three sexy ladies, right? There might be a steamy situation unfolding.」
「Nah. He's probably being made to do the cooking. Poor thing.」
「Not only can he, he's pro-level. He was telling me before that he won first place in some cooking contest.」
「He's made great osechi too. You can come and eat some, if you like. There might be some drunks around, though.」(TL: Traditional Japanese New Year dishes, in a bento-like box.)
「Come to think of it, in my home world, there is no Mikuruma Shrine anymore.」
「I think I heard it, like, got destroyed, when there was some big battle with a mysterious enemy there a hundred years or so ago.」
「Oooh, a mysterious enemy! People from space, or the future, or a parallel world or something?」
「You really like that kind of stuff, don't you?」
「I like it too, but it's a mystery, so I dunno. I mean, from my point of view, this world is the alternate one, and the future.」
「I've got no idea what you're talking about.」
「Still, for the shrine to not be there anymore... Guess there are some places in your alternate world that really are pretty different.」
「I know, right? That's why I'm looking forward to seeing the real thing.」
「That's as may be, but you'd better hide yourself in my shadow soon. There's sure to be other Taimanin up there.」
「Guess I'll have to hide after all. Well, 'scuse me a sec.」
Sakura slipped into my shadow disappointedly.
The grounds of the shrine at the top of the mountain were quite a large open area.
Tonight being New Year's Eve, bonfires were burning.
And, as I thought, other Taimanin besides us had shown up as well.
Once we passed under the torii gate and ascended the steps, the number of preceding visitors grew even further.
「There's a fair few people here, huh?」
「No kidding. Everyone was thinking the same thing, weren't they?」
「It's better with lots of people, right? A deserted shrine at night'd be scary.」
「It's not like any phantoms or whatever are going to show up. It's a holy site, after all.」
「That's got nothing to do with it!」
「Clear, Karasu, be careful you don't get separated, okay? Shall we hold hands?」
「I wonder if there's anybody we know? ......Ah, Mari-chan is here.」
The figure of Shinohara Mari, an Earth Escape user, could be seen among the assembled Taimanin. She appeared to have come with friends.
Although she was in a different class from us, she and Hebiko were close, due to their Class President connection.
Hebiko stretched out while waving her hand, at which point her recipient noticed, and also waved with a smiling face.
Her eyes met mine as well, and I raised my hand slightly to greet her with a 「Yo.」
Mari made a face which looked like she wanted to come over here, but, perhaps because the friend next to her had started to talk to her, she only bowed her head.
The one who had started talking to us was Akiyama Rinko-senpai. Kise Hotaru-senpai and Ootori Shuka-senpai were with her too.
「You've got a pretty big group there, huh?」
「Ah, Rinko-senpai! And good evening to you too, Hotaru-senpai and Shuka-senpai. Yeah, we're all here.」
「Um-hmm. New Year's Day is the key to the year. Welcoming the start of the year at a storied shrine is a good practice for a Taimanin.」
「I know, right? But you don't have Rinka-senpai with you, huh?」
Certainly, Shido Rinka-senpai, known as one of the “Two Rins in the Taimanin” wasn't there.
「Nighttime doesn't agree with her. She said she doesn't like the cold, either. She's a hopeless girl.」
「It's not really my thing either, though...... Haaahhh!」
「But the stars are beautiful tonight. Hey, everyone, please look!」
Enticed by Hotaru-senpai, I looked upwards, and the whole sky was indeed full of stars.
「Really beautiful... Looks like it's going to be a wonderful New Year.」
「By the way, Fuuma. What's with the paper bags? They smell kind of like fish.」
「Why'd you bring something like that? A Fuuma family New Year's Eve tradition or something?」
「We don't have any tradition like that. It's a so-called “present” from Yukikaze. You want one? These are heavy.」
「I guess I'll take one. They look delicious. May I have one, Yukikaze-chan?」
Hotaru-senpai hoisted out one of the kanpu-boshi.
「Haaahhh...... Hotaru, what time is it now?」
Perhaps because she had heard that exchange, Sakura, who was hiding in my shadow, began to stealthily talk to me.
「Fuuma-kun, Fuuma-kun. I wanna go somewhere with a little less people, okay?」
「I wanna come out too, at least for the countdown!」
「Everyone, let's change location for a bit.」
「Eh? Why? This place is fine, isn't it?」
I silently pointed at my own shadow.
「Ah, I see. Rinko-senpai, we're gonna be down there, okay?」
「You're not going to do the countdown here?」
「I mean, come on—Fuuma reeks of fish. He'll spoil it for everybody.」
We had returned to the open space with the bonfires.
「Sakura, come out at the moment of the countdown. That way, no one'll find out.」
A cat had emerged from some nearby bushes.
「There are a lot of cats for some reason, aren't there?」
「We've been seeing a lot of them for the last little while, haven't we?」
「Remind me, was this area somewhere where stray cats gather?」
As soon as she said that, with a meow, another one came into view.
Clear and Karasu petted its head, but the cat immediately went off in the direction of the main shrine.
「The cats wanna do a New Year's celebration too, huh?」
「That's because next year is the Year of the Rat, right? They're probably hurrying so they're not late this time.」
「That old story of the zodiac? Wow, that brings Hebiko back.」
「It's been a really long time since I heard that one.」
「Doesn't Clear know? We have these kind of stories in Japan. Let me see... Once upon a time, the heavenly gods were―――」
Yukikaze recited to Clear, who tilted her head in confusion, an old tale about the zodiac cycle.

The one about how, when the heavenly gods told the animals that they would decide the zodiac on New Year's morning, in order of arrival, the cats got tricked by the rats into thinking it would be January 2nd, and so had missed
their chance to become part of the cycle.
「But thanks to that, ever since then, the cats have started eating all the rats they like. And they all lived happily ever after.」
「You're all together, I see. Good evening, both to those of you I haven't seen for a while, and those I haven't met before.」
All of a sudden, a miko called out to us.
Hers was a face I had never seen in Gosha before—and what was more, she was a beautiful, blonde girl.
「Do you not know me in this outfit? You aided me before, during the evil Christmas spirit uproar. Well then, let me introduce myself again.」
「I'm Lilith Abel Bindernagel, a great witch renowned through the demon world......'s granddaughter. And this is Berylic, my talking dog and companion.」
Due to that name, and long introduction, Hebiko and I remembered.
「It's been a while, Lilith-chan. And you too, Doggy-chan.」
「I am not a doggy. I am Berylic, an ancient dragon......」
「Wow, the dog talked! Eh? What? Someone you two know?」
「What, what? A blonde miko's appeared? And a talking dog?」
「What's happening? What's going on? I wanna see too! I'm coming out now!」
Unable to hold herself back, Sakura emerged from my shadow.
「Wow, it's true. It's a blonde miko. It's the first time I've seen one like this. She's super-duper cute!」
「Ordinarily, I dress in the manner of a great witch, but I decided to try and be all snappy and miko-like today. Berylic's got a headdress too, so we match!」
「Miko clothes sure are cute. I wanna try wearing something like that for a change.」
Lilith's companion, Berylic—who appeared to be a talking dog but was in fact an ancient dragon (apparently)—was breathing a resigned-sounding sigh due to the excited girls.
Previously, one night at Christmastime, an evil snowman spirit who harboured a grudge against a city's couples had gone on a rampage.

Hebiko and I happened to be in that city, and had gotten dragged into that rampage, but it was Lilith, this “Legendary Great Witch's Grandchild”, who had purified that spirit with her tremendous magical powers (although
her command of them was questionable).
After explaining the whole story of that, and introducing each other, I asked
「Why are you being a miko of all things?」
「It's for my witch training, of course.」
「There's a witch named Neu-san in Amidahara, who's a friend of my late grandmother.」
「She told me that something would happen at this shrine on New Year's Eve this year.」
「So I couldn't contain myself. I got these cute miko clothes ready and rushed straight over!」
「She told me to check that out with my own eyes.」
「As you might expect from a friend of Obaa-sama, Neu-san is a mischievous one as well, so it's sure to be a hell of a thing♪」
「Well, I rather think there's no doubt.」
Berylic nodded to the excited-looking Lilith with a face that said, “Good grief.”
I couldn't help but remember last New Year's, when I had been summoned to a parallel world, and made to take the place of an auspicious boar.
I wasn't going to get flung into some alternate world again, and be made an auspicious rat this time, was I?
Or else, would something appear, like that evil Christmas spirit, or the Halloween one a little while ago?
「I suppose an evil kadomatsu spirit will show up this time, or something.」(TL: Traditional New Year's decorations.)
「There's a kadomatsu spirit? I've never seen one of those. But then, that doesn't sound so great.」
「I doubt that is going to happen. This area is brimming with holy energy. No mere spirit could enter.」
「But, I do get the feeling that something is going to happen.」
「Berylic's premonitions are always right! If anything happens, please be sure to let me know, okay?♪」
「Ah, oh no. It'll be the countdown soon. Well then, excuuuse meee!」
Lilith hectically hurried back into the main shrine.
「What a weird girl that was. Sure does have a witchy feel to her.」
「There's no doubt that she has a lot of potential.」
「Well, first of all, there's the countdown.」
「You're right. Okay, starting ten seconds before.」
It was almost the beginning of the year.
The clamorous shrine fell absolutely silent.
Chanting began in unison throughout the shrine, including the other Taimanin besides us.
For some reason, I was the only one chanting zero.
No one else was letting their voice out.
Not just Yukikaze and the others, but all the rest of the Taimanin were frozen.
They were paused at the moment of chanting 「1」, and didn't move, or even twitch.
It was like they had turned to stone.
Had everything but me been subjected to Petrification Arts or something?
Had the whole world come to a stop?
I couldn't hear any sound whatsoever. There was no airflow, either.
Even the fires in the iron baskets were frozen like statues.
And the winged insects that had approached the flames were frozen in midair.
Was this the 『hell of a thing』 that Lilith had been talking about?
It certainly seemed that way, but why had time stopped, and why was I the only one who could move?
It was so sudden that I couldn't grasp the situation at all.
Out of nowhere, the mewling of several cats had become audible.
It was from the direction of the main shrine.
I headed that way for starters.
I passed through the torii gates, and ran up the steps.
For some reason, I got the feeling that there was something strange about my body, but I couldn't afford to worry too much about that.
All of the Taimanin on the grounds, such as Rinko-senpai, were no longer moving.
The only things moving were me, and the cats.
The cats were lined up in a neat circle, and simultaneously howling towards the sky.
What the hell was going on?!
「Otherworld Devil-san!! I'm sorry, but please go back home!!」
I had heard the voice of someone other than the cats.
With her golden hair fluttering over her miko clothes, she was shouting at some kind of godlike thing.
Something that was distorting time and space, trying to come from its dimension into this world.
「Miko of this world! You should welcome the great cat god Bastet, nya! Nya nya nya nya nyaaaaa!!」
That was a goddess who appeared in Egyptian mythology, and, if I remembered rightly, she was supposed to be a cat god.
However, no matter how I looked at it, that thing was a giant, black “beckoning cat” figure.
「If a demon god with enormous power like you were to force your way in, it would upset the balance of this world!」
「I'm sorry, but I must obstruct you! Go, magic barrier that blocks all things!! <i>Unce Mashah Bulbar Rier!!<i>」
While raising both hands, Lilith chanted an incantation, at which point a shining magical wall appeared.
When I last met her, she had been messing up her spells constantly, but it looked like she had undertaken a great deal of training since then.
「Unyanyaaaa!! What is this barrier, nyaaaaa?!! It's in the way, nya! I can't get through, nyaaaa!!」
Thwarted by that magical barrier, Bastet was unable to come into this world.
The cats unanimously made displeased-sounding cries of 「Nyaa, nyaa!!」
「Lilith! What the hell is that thing?!」
「Ah, Divine Boar Beast-san! You've mustered the last of your strength to come to my aid!!」
「I'm most deeply grateful. Please lend me your power, I beg of you!」
「What are you talking about? It's me, it's Fuuma!」
「Eh? Fuuma-san? But, what's with that form? You've become a boar!」
Only after being told that did I realize it.
Unbeknownst to me, I had transformed into a boar again.
It was Kiyomaro, the auspicious beast which had made me take its place last New Year's.
「Fuuma-san, were you secretly a divine beast? Ah! So that's why you're always together with that octopus demon, Hebiko-san!」
「No, I'm not! Why am I in this form again?! No, more importantly, what's happening? What is that big lucky cat?!」
「It's Bastet-san, a demon god from another world! The cats are trying to summon her!」
「It's kind of complicated. They have a story that's as tear-jerking to hear as it is to tell. I'm sorry, Berylic, if you would, please.」
「I suppose I'll have to. There's something called a “zodiac”, you see. Once upon a time, the heavenly gods―――」
「Wait a sec! Don't tell me the cats've shown up because they feel bitter about not getting to be in the zodiac!」
「It does help that I need say no more.」
「Wait wait wait! Why are they showing up now?! In any case, that was just an old folk tale, wasn't it?」
「Even mere folk tales take on real power through everyone retelling them.」
「Thoughts do create something from nothing. That's a fundament of the magic arts, right?」
「The feelings of resentment among the cats, who were tricked by the rats and missed their opportunity to be in the zodiac, appear to have finally reached their peak.」
「And just when that happened, the next year was the Year of the Rat. They seem intent on summoning this cat demon god from the Otherworld, to turn the Year of the Rat into the Year of the Cat.」
「It would appear that the divine beasts of the zodiac are extending the time between 11:59:59 and midnight perpetually, to try and prevent that.」
「So that's why it looks like time has stopped?」
「I can move, though, thanks to the great magical powers bequeathed to me by Obaa-sama. And also Berylic's help.」
「Why am I able to move? And, what's with this form?」
「Who knows? But, Fuuma-san, you are sparkling with divine power for some reason.」
「It's faint, but I sense the power of an auspicious beast from you. That is probably why you have taken such a form. Do you not know anything about that?」
One year ago, I had been turned into this auspicious beast.
Its good-luck energy or something must have still remained in my body.
A parting gift from Kiyomaro, huh? The kind you'd be both grateful and ungrateful for.
「At this rate, next year will never come. I'm holding it back with my magical barrier for now, but obviously I can't do it forever.」
「If Bastet-san forces her way in, the world is sure to be wrecked in a huge clash with the Rat God.」
「That certainly would be a hell of a thing.」
「We will have to do something about it ourselves, won't we?」
Our opponent appeared to be a demon god from another world.
It didn't seem like an opponent that one could win against by battling.
「Nya nya?! You mean to obstruct me, nya? I won't let you do that, nya!!」
「Come, my followers! Drive away the ones who impede me, nyaaaa!! Unya nya nya nyaaaa～～～!」
「Oh, this is terrible! Bastet-san has summoned something!」
Space distorted around us, and some figures suddenly popped out.
「Nyaaan! I'm Mercy, nyaa! Who's summoned me all of a sudden, nyaa?!!」
「Nya nya nya! Where is this place, nya? I was just about to sleep, nyaaa～!」
「Unyanyaaa!! What's this all of a sudden, nya?!! Don't just casually summon me, nya!」
「Mighty cats! Fight together with me, Bastet, nya! Then, we will make the Year of the Cat a reality, nya!」
「Funyanyaa?! The Cat God is here, nya! This is amazing, nya!」
「Mmm, there's a God of Cats, nya? Is she going to feed me, nya? I'll help out if that's the case, nya!」
「Mmm, nyahh?! Cat God, you say? Fight for a Year of the Cat? Sounds fun, nya! I'll do it, nya!!」
「They appear to be cat followers from this world, hmm? I suppose it's because Bastet herself is still in the world on the other side.」
「It would seem that she most likely intends to use that lot to eliminate any obstacles.」
「It's a cat beastman trio, eh? They seem kind of strong, don't they?」
「Given that no one else here can move except us...」
「And I'd rather curl up under the kotatsu, nya.」
「I'll fight! Just who exactly're the enemies, nya?!」
「It looks like they don't really understand the situation yet. All right, victory comes to he who strikes first!」
I charged at the three of them.
This was my second time morphing into this body. I knew how to use it.
It was a charge which made use of the enormous boar's power.
「A big boar, nya? That one looks like a god too, nya?」
「A charge attack?! You got some nerve, doing that to me, nya!」
However, right on the verge of my boar tackle, the three of them all jumped at once.
「「「Nyan-pachiriii!!」」」(TL: A catchphrase of Nyanko-sensei, the talking cat from Inakappe Taishou, used when he performs his “Cat Aerial Triple-Spin”.)
The three of them all deftly dodged my charge with spectacular somersaults.
「Amazing! It's a Cat Aerial Triple-Spin, nya! Oh no. I've caught their speech patterns!」
「Is this any time to be giving exposition?!」
The three of them were attacking me from the air.
Taking advantage of my charge attack having been evaded, I maintained my speed, and somehow managed to dodge them.
「You're strong, nya! I've started wanting to show my true strength, nya!」
「Mer wants you to stay still, nya. It'll be easier to claw you, nya!」
I could tell from that one exchange of attacks just now.
Perhaps because they were being lent Bastet's might, the three of them had fearsome power and speed.
It didn't seem like I could match them just on my own, even with this auspicious beast body.
「Lilith! Can't you do something with that great magic power of yours?!!」
「I'd like to very much, but it's all I can do to hold Bastet-san back with my magical barrier so she can't come over here.」
「I'm sorry, but please do your best!」
「Berylic! What about you?! Aren't you actually an ancient dragon?!」
「I thank you for remembering. However, the best I can do is to make it so that Lilith is able to move in this frozen world.」
「I'm sorry, but please do battle against them by yourself.」
So in other words, even though they were both able to move, neither of them could move?
「Come on, Berylic, let's cheer for Fuuma-san. Hooray, hooray, Fuuma-san! Go!」
And then, some familiar, rather godlike laughter resounded.
It was Juno, the goddess of June, who half a year ago had been released from her sealing jar, and tried to make me marry Anje from the UFS.
「The human who pissed me off recently's turned into an auspicious beast. Laaaaaame!」
Ill-natured as may have been, she was indeed a goddess. She appeared to have figured out that it was me at a glance.
She must have grasped the situation as well, of course.
「Yeah right. Just killing time. It's not gonna be the New Year no matter how much time goes by, so Juno just came to see what was at the epicentre of the time stop.」
「Juno doesn't really care about stuff like the zodiac. It's like, do whatever you want.」
「Aren't you planning to come to me this June?! As it stands, June's never going to arrive, ever!」
「In that case, I won't be doing those pain-in-the-ass blessings anymore.」
Was this what gods were like, at the end of the day?
「Juno! It has been a long time.」
「Eh? Berylic? Wow, long time no see♪ Why'd you turn into a dog like that?」
They appeared to know each other.
Juno was making a slightly happy-looking face.
「Well, it's complicated... More importantly, could you lend us your power? If things continue as they are, it will be a problem for me as well, you see.」
「That so? If it's Berylic's request, I guess there's nothing for it. But fighting myself's such a chooore!」
「All I require is for you to summon a helper or two.」
「Well, if that's all. Treat me to something one of these days, okay? All right, I don't care who, just c'mere!」
While calling out with half-assed words, Juno emitted a divine light, at which point space distorted again, and backup popped out.
「Wha?! Where is this?! Why am I dressed this way?!」
Yubashiri Hayate, a fellow Gosha Academy Taimanin, and an archer from a renowned family.
「Hey, what's happening all of a sudden?! Uwaah, is this a wedding dress? Wh-What's the meaning of this?」
Aina Winchester, who had previously gotten dragged into some trouble with me at a summer beach, where we got showered with sexual energy.
「Where's this? And, these clothes. Ah, Juno's here again.」
And Anje, whom I hadn't seen for half a year.
All three of them were acquaintances of mine, but they appeared to have been transferred to this place abruptly, and were all unable to hide their surprise.
「Why are they all in wedding dresses?!」
「Kyahahahaha!! Obviously they'd be like that if Juno summons them!!」
「Whoa, I'm freaked! Wh-What's with these guys? Everyone around's stopped!」
「Is this Mikuruma Shrine? A goddess and a boar, a miko and a lucky cat? What the hell is going on?!」
「Strange. Juno is here, but Fuuma's not.」
「I am here, Anje! And Hayate! Aina!」
「I may look like this, but it's me. It's Fuuma!!」
「Fuuma?! Is this your doing?!! You made me wear a thing like this?!」
「Y-You're Fuuma? Hey, don't look, moron!! It's embarrassing, ya know! Don't look!!」
「Fuuma, you turned into a boar? I don't really mind, though. Are we getting married again?」
「I-I'll explain later. Anyway, time's stopped. The world's in a major pinch!」
「Our opponents are that black lucky cat, and those cat beastmen.」
「The miko and the white dog are our allies, but they can't move. I'm sorry, please help us!」
「I dunno what that means, all that “world's in a major pinch out of nowhere” stuff! I'm dressed like this! You're gonna give me a proper explanation after!」
「Mmmm. I understand that it's a state of emergency. But don't stare too hard!!」
「Fufun, three more people, huh? This has finally gotten interesting, nya!」
「Me, I got tired of waiting and started getting sleepy, nya. But I'll hang in there for the reward, nyaaa～」
「Mer's got just a little into it too, nya. I'll gladly fight with you all, nya!」
「Nya nya nyaaaaa～～～～!! I won't allow you to hold back cats, nyaaa!」
Bastet stretched larger, and her entire body began to sparkle.
